description: Unified progress indicator combining accessibility attributes, supporting circular or linear representation with a label and formatted value.

props.absolute: Positions the component absolutely within its parent, centering the progress indicator and placing details without affecting layout.
props.type: Determines which progress indicator to render.
props.label: Text displayed alongside the progress indicator and placed in `aria-label`.
props.detailsPosition: Controls the position of the details (label and value) relative to the progress indicator.
props.max: Sets the maximum value for the progress indicator.
props.reveal: Animates the progress indicator from 0 to its model value when the component mounts.
props.transition: Controls the animation to a new value. Pass `{ duration }` in milliseconds or as a CSS duration (`0.4s`), or `false` to remove it. Does not affect the `indeterminate` animation.
props.valueFormat: Formatter for the visible value text and `aria-valuetext`. Use `[value]` and `[max]` as placeholders in strings, or pass a function that receives `{ value, max }` and returns a string.
